quiz.quiz_title: The Unlikely Best Friends Master Quiz

questions.question: Why was Gajaraj the royal elephant sad despite enjoying royal luxuries?

options.A: He was given cold food by the mahout.
options.B: He lacked a companion to play with and suffered from loneliness.
options.C: He was kept tied in a dark cave.
options.D: He wanted to leave the kingdom permanently.

questions.explanation: Gajaraj was lonely because he had no true friends to play with, as his caretaker only looked after physical needs.

questions.question: How did Gajaraj react when Buntee the stray dog entered his shed?

options.A: He chased Buntee away with his trunk.
options.B: He generously shared his meal with Buntee.
options.C: He alerted the royal guards immediately.

questions.explanation: Gajaraj welcomed Buntee warmly and shared his food, initiating their friendship.

questions.question: True or False: Gajaraj continued eating normally after Buntee was sold to a farmer.
questions.explanation: Gajaraj was heartsick and refused both food and his daily bath after Buntee was taken away.

questions.question: How did the King solve Gajaraj's illness?

options.C: By ordering Buntee's immediate return to reunite the best friends.
options.D: By sending Gajaraj to the forest.

questions.explanation: Realizing Gajaraj was grieving his lost friend, the King ordered Buntee to be brought back.
